statements.t: In addition, recent investments in seasoned commercial banking talent have already introduced Pathfinder to growing numbers of proven borrowers and sponsors, providing a new pipeline of commercial real estate loan production that we expect to begin funding in the fourth quarter.

While we are not immune to the upward pressure the industry is widely expected to see in deposit costs, we believe Pathfinder’s market position, customer relationships, and pricing discipline provide a solid foundation for building on our core deposit base going forward.”
